detail.longDescription: 🪰 NEW: Researchers analyzing # walking in # fruitflies , # mice , and # humans discovered that despite their anatomical differences, all three species exhibit the same joint-velocity pattern, where limbs farther from the body move faster than those closer to it. This fundamental principle of motor control stays constant even as # aging affects each # species differently, suggesting that they share evolutionary # solutions to # locomotion . 👉 https:// phys.org/news/2026-09-flies-mi ce-humans-pattern-radically.html # biomechanics # animals # evolution # flies # insects # anatomy # physiology # research # neuroscience # biology # science
